verdict: Figma grew revenue 46% to $333M — growth accelerating for a second straight quarter as AI products pulled in bigger customers — but $169M of post-IPO stock pay drove a $142M GAAP loss; excluding stock pay, operations earned $52M.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: vs a year ago — accelerating from +40% in Q4 2025

segments.name: Subscriptions & AI credits
segments.note: Design-tool subscriptions (per-seat plans for Figma, Dev Mode, Make and Sites) plus usage credits for AI features. Figma reports one revenue stream. AI credit limits for all seats began March 18, 2026.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the design platform and its AI features — includes $79.0M of stock pay.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling seats to design and product teams.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day — includes $63.9M of stock pay.

follow100Note: Rows add up with a small rounding difference. Costs ran to about $143 per $100 of revenue — the extra is the loss, covered by cash the company already had.

takeaways.title: Growth accelerated again
takeaways.text: Revenue growth quickened from 38% in Q3 2025 to 40% in Q4 and 46% in Q1, and Figma raised its full-year revenue outlook to $1.422–1.428B.

takeaways.title: Customers keep expanding
takeaways.text: Net dollar retention hit 139% — its highest in over two years — as existing customers spent 39% more than a year ago; customers paying over $100k a year grew 48%.

takeaways.title: Stock pay is the loss
takeaways.text: Stock-based compensation was $169M in the quarter. Without it and related items, Figma earned $52M of operating income and $57M of net income (non-GAAP), and free cash flow was $89M.

oneTimers: Figma listed on the NYSE in July 2025. Newly public companies often show large GAAP losses as employee stock awards vest: stock-based compensation was $169M this quarter, versus just $0.2M in Q1 2025 before the IPO.
otherDetail: Other expense of $4.3M, net — a $15.6M unrealized loss on equity investments and a $3.3M writedown of digital assets, partly offset by interest earned on Figma's cash and investments.
footerNote: GAAP figures include $169M of stock-based compensation.
